subject: FinServCo SIG request: CI/codeflow and secrets governance artifacts
messages:
From: Keith Turner <keith.turner@finservco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: sec-audit@finservco.com
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — CI, code review & secrets evidence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the earlier call. FinServCo's external assessor (SecAssess) is starting the SIG/CAIQ intake and they've asked us for a compact set of artifacts specifically tied to Secure SDLC controls:

- Evidence of code review process + sampling (PR policy, reviewer rotation)
- CI/CD pipeline controls and approval gates, including any ephemeral credential use
- Secrets lifecycle and rotation policy (HSM/KMS usage, ephemeral token sampling)
- Change management logs that show rollbacks, emergency patches, and approvals

Our deadline for the initial evidence bundle is next Wednesday EOD (2028-05-10). Can Redwood provide a scoped bundle and a short attestation on process ownership? If possible, please include a handful of redacted artifacts we can hand to the assessor — we only need representative examples, not full logs.

Appreciate it — Keith

--
Keith Turner
Head of Vendor Risk, FinServCo
keith.turner@finservco.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Keith Turner <keith.turner@finservco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — CI, code review & secrets evidence

Hi Keith,

Thanks — we can assemble a concise bundle for SecAssess by 2028-05-10. High level plan:

1) Code review: 2 PR samples (one routine, one emergency-hotfix) + our PR template and reviewer rotation policy.
2) CI/CD controls: pipeline diagram, sample pipeline run (redacted), branch protection rules, and approval gate config (Jenkins/GitHub Actions snippets).
3) Secrets: token rotation policy (PDF), a redacted key-access log showing ephemeral token exchange, and KMS usage notes.
4) Change management: annotated change log CSV showing approvals, canary dates, and rollback example.

I'll coordinate artifacts; Jordan will pull the code-review samples and Irene will supply CI run artifacts and the pipeline diagram. Marissa — please confirm the attestation language for process ownership so we can include it.

I'll upload everything to a shared Drive link and send a DocuSign attestation if that helps the assessor.

Best,
Mina

Mina Haddad
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — CI, code review & secrets evidence

On Thu, May 3, 2028 at 10:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Code review: 2 PR samples (one routine, one emergency-hotfix) + our PR template and reviewer rotation policy.

I've pulled two representative PRs:
- PR #4823: feature/llm-routing — standard review flow, includes test checklist and reviewer comments (redacted)
- PR #5017: hotfix/kv-cache-fix — emergency patch, expedited approvals and rollback notes

I exported the review history into code-review-sampling.csv (redacted authors/emails) and included short notes mapping each PR to SIG control references. Attaching CSV and a short README describing redaction approach.

I'll drop the files into the shared Drive folder Mina creates.

—Jordan
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — CI, code review & secrets evidence

Attached pipeline diagram (ci-pipeline-diagram.png) and a redacted pipeline run export. Notes:
- We use ephemeral runner tokens for deploy jobs; runner tokens are rotated per-job with a TTL of 10 minutes.
- Approval gates are enforced by protected branches + required status checks; emergency deploys require a documented rollback plan and two approvers (one from SRE, one from Eng).
- I included sample workflow YAML snippets showing masked secrets usage via KMS key references (not raw values).

Also attaching token-rotation-policy.pdf which describes rotation cadence for service tokens and our KMS key rotation schedule.

Irene
Senior Platform Engineer
From: sec-audit@finservco.com <sec-audit@finservco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Keith Turner <keith.turner@finservco.com>, Auditor, SecAssess <audit@sec-assess.com>
Date: Mon, 8 May 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — CI, code review & secrets evidence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the updates and the planned artifacts. A couple quick clarifications from the assessor so we can scope review:

1) For the PR samples — can you confirm there are reviewer attestations (i.e., explicit approval records) captured in the PR metadata?
2) For the redacted pipeline run — can you include a timeline showing when the ephemeral token exchange occurred relative to the deploy step?
3) For change management — the assessor prefers a compact CSV with change id, requester, approver(s), approval timestamps, and rollback flag.

If you can surface those three items in the Drive folder we should be able to proceed without a live interview. Let me know if DocuSign attestation will be necessary.

Cheers,
FinServCo Security Intake
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: sec-audit@finservco.com <sec-audit@finservco.com>, Keith Turner <keith.turner@finservco.com>, Auditor, SecAssess <audit@sec-assess.com>

Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivering requested artifacts — FinServCo SIG intake

Hi Keith / SecAssess team,

We've uploaded the requested evidence bundle to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c-finservco-evidence

Included items (redacted where appropriate):
- code-review-sampling.csv — reviewer approvals included as approval_status and approval_timestamp columns
- ci-pipeline-diagram.png + pipeline-run-20280428.json (redacted) — pipeline-run includes an event timeline showing ephemeral token issuance at 2028-04-28T22:14:03Z and deploy step at 2028-04-28T22:14:26Z
- token-rotation-policy.pdf — formal policy with rotation cadence and KMS key IDs (redacted)
- change-management-log.csv — columns: change_id, summary, requester_id (redacted), approvers (roles), approval_timestamps, rollback_performed (yes/no)
- README_evidence_handling.md — explains redaction approach and points reviewers to the relevant SIG control mappings

Attestation: Marissa (copied) has approved the bundle and will sign the attestation certifying that the artifacts are representative samples of our standard processes. We'll send the DocuSign link after your confirmation that the bundle is in scope.

If the assessor needs any additional context or a short walkthrough, Jordan and I can join a 30-minute session next week.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
